Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.match

Class RegionBasedProofer

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.match.RegionBasedProofer
All Implemented Interfaces:
MatchProofer
@Component public class RegionBasedProofer extends Object implements MatchProofer
Validates matches by ensuring they fall within designated search regions.

This implementation of MatchProofer verifies that found matches are contained entirely within the specified search regions. This is crucial for constraining searches to specific areas of the screen and avoiding false positives from unintended areas.

Limitation: Matches that span multiple adjacent regions may be rejected even if they partially overlap valid search areas, as the validation requires complete containment within a single region.

  • Method Details

    • isInSearchRegions

      public boolean isInSearchRegions(Match match, ActionConfig actionConfig, Pattern pattern)
      Validates if a match falls within the allowed search regions for a pattern.

      This method retrieves the appropriate search regions based on the action options and pattern configuration, then checks if the match is contained within any of these regions. Since regions are unique, there's no risk of duplicate validation.

      When coordinate scaling is active (e.g., with DPI scaling), this method handles the conversion between physical coordinates (from FFmpeg capture) and logical coordinates (for search regions) to ensure accurate containment checks.

      Specified by:
      isInSearchRegions in interface MatchProofer
      Parameters:
      match - The match to validate (in physical coordinates from FFmpeg)
      actionConfig - Configuration that may specify search regions
      pattern - The pattern that may have its own search region constraints
      Returns:
      true if the match is contained within at least one search region, false otherwise
      See Also:
      • SearchRegionResolver.getRegions(ActionConfig, Pattern)

    • isInSearchRegions

      public boolean isInSearchRegions(Match match, List<Region> regions)
      Checks if a match is completely contained within any of the provided regions.

      This method iterates through all search regions and returns true if the match is fully contained within at least one region. Note that matches spanning multiple adjacent regions will be rejected, as the validation requires complete containment within a single region. This is a known limitation that may cause valid matches to be filtered out in edge cases.

      When coordinate scaling is active (e.g., with DPI scaling), this method scales the match region from physical coordinates (FFmpeg capture resolution) to logical coordinates (display resolution) before performing containment checks. This ensures accurate validation when captures are done at a different resolution than the display.

      Specified by:
      isInSearchRegions in interface MatchProofer
      Parameters:
      match - The match to validate (in physical coordinates from FFmpeg)
      regions - The list of search regions to check against (in logical coordinates)
      Returns:
      true if the match is completely contained within at least one region, false if the match is outside all regions or spans multiple regions
